cases.prompt: Our pods get killed during deploys and drop in-flight requests. How do we shut down gracefully?
assertions: Implements graceful shutdown: SIGTERM handling, readiness flip, connection draining, terminationGracePeriodSeconds
Separates startup from liveness and readiness probes with correct thresholds
Externalizes config/state and emits structured logs with correlation IDs (12-factor)
